svg.title: Figure 1 - AMMPER simulation and ROS model results
svg.desc: Two-row seven-panel scientific figure rebuilt from supplied panel assets. Panels B/C and E/F use shared titles; E/F use a shared legend below the plots. Wild Type is written in full, the vector plot typography is enlarged, and all y-axis titles are shifted slightly left. The SVG canvas is set to 7.000 inches wide by 3.640662 inches high for ASM publication sizing.

text.tspan: Sample sizes (n) are shown as Wild Type/rad51Δ.
